page: Microsoft Azure F8alds_v7 is a compute-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Faldsv7 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor with an x86_64 architecture. The CPU operates at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz and includes 32 MB of L3 cache. The system is configured with 16.0 GB of RAM, yielding a low memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It includes 945 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, though it does not bundle any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data reveals top-tier single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU metrics, gzip compression, and bzip3 decompression all placing in the top 10% of tested systems. Multi-core performance, however, falls into the average range, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU scores. Memory bandwidth for both small cached blocks and large uncached blocks is average, alongside standard database operations and Redis SET throughput. For machine learning workloads, the server achieves top-tier text generation speeds on small 135M parameter models, but scales down to average performance for larger 7B parameter models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the F8alds_v7 offers high single-threaded compute density and fast local storage without the premium cost of high-memory configurations. The primary tradeoff is the low memory allocation of 2.0 GB per vCPU, which limits its suitability for memory-intensive databases or massive datasets. This server is best suited for compute-bound workloads that benefit from high clock speeds and local storage, such as single-threaded processing tasks, web serving, lightweight build systems, and small-scale machine learning inference.
description: Microsoft Azure F8alds_v7 is an x86_64 compute-optimized virtual machine powered by an 8-core AMD EPYC 9V45 processor running at 4.5 GHz. It features 16.0 GB of RAM, providing a low memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU, and includes 945 GB of local storage. Operating on Microsoft Hyper-V, this server delivers top-tier single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU, gzip compression, and bzip3 decompression benchmarks ranking in the top 10%. However, its multi-core performance and memory bandwidth remain in the average tier. The F8alds_v7 provides a cost-effective option for compute-heavy tasks that do not require large memory footprints, making it highly suitable for web serving, single-threaded batch processing, and lightweight machine learning inference.
